summary: Iteration 37 — Offline Photo E2E + Offline Job Badge + X-Messenger. RESULT: Offline Job Badge PASSES end-to-end (badge appears, sky-100 color, persists after reload, only on offline-saved job). X-Messenger PASSES (data-testid=add-aerial-X-Messenger present in Aerial group of Add dropdown). OFFLINE PHOTO E2E FAILS — two BLOCKER bugs found: (a) `db.savePhotoBlob` promise resolves and warning toast fires but IndexedDB `photoQueue` store remains EMPTY (getAll returned 0 records 2.5s after `[MultiPhotoUpload] Calling onChange with: [offline-photo://...]` was logged); (b) the offline pole PUT is NOT queued — `syncQueue` also empty after Save Pole while offline, no queued-offline toast. Because both queues are empty, syncOfflinePhotos has nothing to upload and the pole's birthmark_photos stayed [] on the server across a 75s poll after reconnect. Online photo upload regression path (immediate URL) was not exercised because the offline-photo flow hangs the test earlier, but the same POST /upload-photo path works via curl and is unchanged code.

ui_bugs.issue: After awaiting db.savePhotoBlob(...), the photoQueue objectStore in IndexedDB (PoleDataOffline, v2) contains 0 records. queuePhotoOffline resolves successfully (placeholder returned, warning toast fires, form state gets offline-photo:// URL) but the blob is never actually persisted. As a result useOfflinePhotoUrl → getPhotoBlob returns null and NO blob-URL renders as a thumbnail in the form, and syncOfflinePhotos on reconnect finds an empty queue and uploads nothing.

Clicking Save on the pole edit form while context.set_offline(True) logs `[PoleForm] Submitting data:` and network `ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED` but produces NO 'No signal — saved on this device' toast and NO syncQueue entry (getAll on syncQueue returned 0). The offline interceptor either does not intercept axios PUT /poles/{id} at all or the queueAction fails silently. Iteration 34 verified POST /poles works offline; this regression is on the update path — the whole offline-edit-a-pole flow is broken.

integration_issues.flow: Offline photo capture → reconnect → auto-upload → PUT record with real URL
integration_issues.issue: End-to-end broken because upstream photoQueue is empty. Polled GET /api/jobs/{jobId}/poles every 5s for 75s after network came back + dispatched window online event — birthmark_photos stayed []. The 'Uploaded N offline photo' success toast never fires.

action_items: Investigate why db.savePhotoBlob (offlineDb.js:237-239 → putItem PHOTO_QUEUE) resolves without persisting a record. Possible causes: (i) File blob failing structured-clone at IDB put time in this build silently (add try/catch inside putItem to surface); (ii) dbInstance singleton points to a stale/closed IDBDatabase from a prior version upgrade — consider `dbInstance = null` on `onversionchange` and re-open; (iii) transaction abort due to unhandled `tx.oncomplete/onabort` — current putItem does not listen to tx.onabort. Recommended: wrap put in `new Promise` that resolves on tx.oncomplete rather than request.onsuccess (put's onsuccess fires before tx commit), and reject on tx.onerror / onabort.

Debug why offlineWrites response error interceptor doesn't queue PUT /poles/{id} when navigator.onLine=false. Add a console.warn inside the interceptor path (before/after parseWrite) to confirm it runs; likely candidate: cfg.url is normalized to full URL by axios baseURL and parseWrite's regex may not match the absolute URL, only the relative one. In iter34 the same interceptor worked for POST /poles — regression suggests either recent baseURL change or a route-matching gap for the PUT path.
Add integration test that exercises: offline PUT of an existing pole → confirm syncQueue length increases → reconnect → confirm GET returns updated data.
After the two fixes above, re-run the full offline-photo E2E (login → warm SW → offline → upload photo → save pole offline → online → dispatchEvent('online') → poll for real URL in birthmark_photos).
critical_code_review_comments: offlineDb.js putItem resolves via request.onsuccess which fires BEFORE the transaction is committed. If the tx aborts (structured clone failure for a File, quota, etc.) after onsuccess the record is silently lost — exactly the observed symptom for photoQueue. Fix: resolve on tx.oncomplete and reject on tx.onabort/onerror. Applies to putItem, deleteItem and clearStore.

offlinePhotos.js queuePhotoOffline does not verify the write — it should read back via getPhotoBlob(id) before returning the placeholder, or the caller should treat missing blob as an error and re-throw so MultiPhotoUpload falls into its 'Failed to upload' branch instead of silently pointing the form at an unrecoverable placeholder.

offlineWrites.js interceptor at line 67 rejects any request whose `cfg.data instanceof FormData` — this correctly avoids intercepting /upload-photo, but keep in mind if PUT /poles/{id} ever switches to multipart (e.g. inline photo), the offline queue will silently drop those PUTs.

syncOfflinePhotos gates on `pending.length > 0` (record queue non-empty). If the record queue is empty (as observed here) it proceeds — good — but if the photoQueue is populated and the record queue is drained on an earlier online event, the photos are uploaded and PUTs replace placeholders on records that already exist, which requires those records to exist in local IDB (getAllPoles). If a pole was created and its offline queue drained but the local record was subsequently deleted from IDB, the placeholder rewrite silently drops. Consider also fetching the server record and PUTting authoritatively rather than only relying on locally-cached records.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two independent bugs blocking the offline-photo feature: (1) photoQueue writes not persisting; (2) offline record PUT interceptor not queuing. Test steps that reproduce reliably: login → navigate to /jobs/{jobId}/edit/{poleId} → reload once (SW active) → page.context.set_offline(True) → set_input_files on input[data-testid=birthmark-file-input] with a tiny PNG → wait 2.5s → probe indexedDB.open('PoleDataOffline') photoQueue.getAll() — will be empty despite a successful `1 photo added / No signal — ... saved on this device` toast and `[MultiPhotoUpload] Calling onChange with: [offline-photo://<uuid>]` log. Similarly, clicking Save Pole (data-testid=save-pole-top-btn) while offline yields ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED but syncQueue.getAll() stays empty. Feature B (Save Offline badge) and Feature C (X-Messenger) both fully verified — no need to retest those.
rca of the issue: Most likely root cause for photoQueue emptiness: offlineDb.putItem resolves on `request.onsuccess`, which in IndexedDB fires BEFORE the enclosing readwrite transaction commits. If storing a File/Blob triggers a structured-clone error inside the browser (or the tx is aborted for any reason) after onsuccess resolves, the JS Promise chain proceeds as if the write succeeded while the record is discarded. This matches the observed behavior exactly: placeholder generated, toast shown, but store empty. Fix: rewrite putItem to `resolve()` on tx.oncomplete and `reject(tx.error)` on tx.onerror/onabort. For the syncQueue-not-populated bug: the response error interceptor likely fails to match `cfg.url` for `PUT /poles/{id}` because axios sets cfg.url to the full absolute URL after baseURL is applied but parseWrite matches against a leading `/poles/...` pattern; need to strip baseURL or match with regex that accepts optional origin prefix.
